metadata.name: Lead-210 Sediment Core Measurements from Western Mexico
metadata.description: Dataset containing 210Pb radioactivity measurements (total, supported, and unsupported) from a single sediment core (Event LTp22-1) collected at a single location in western Mexico. The core spans approximately 24 cm in depth with 25 depth-interval samples. Supported 210Pb is constant at 48.4, while unsupported 210Pb varies with depth, missing for the deepest 6 samples where total activity falls below the supported background level.
metadata.spatial: Point location (21.277661°N, 104.690167°W); vertical resolution of 0.005 m (5 mm) sediment depth intervals
metadata.temporal: Single sampling date (2022-04-08); no temporal spread across records
